Chronology of every recorded fact about [[soul-oath]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Unsouled ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|'''Ch 16''' — A soul-oath is a promise where individuals swear on their souls to build trust.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|'''Ch 16''' — The binding power of a soul-oath increases with the strength of the practitioner's spirit.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|'''Ch 16''' — Violating a soul-oath can cause damage to a practitioner's core, with the severity depending on their level.}}

== Dreadgod ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 7''' — A soul oath binds Yerin and Red Faith.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 11''' — Compelled soul oaths are weaker than traditional ones.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 14''' — A soul oath is a type of binding agreement.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 17''' — A soul oath can judge a person's honesty.}}

== Waybound ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|'''Ch 21''' — Akura Malice's soul oath released her when the battle ended.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|'''Ch 22''' — Tiberian has broken many soul oaths.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|'''Ch 33''' — Lindon requires a soul oath from those attending the meeting to keep the peace.}}
